calls.title: Placeholder: Porsche Informatik & Growthbook POC Scoping
calls.summary: The meeting focused on the postponed call with a Porsche client meant to clarify the proof of concept (POC) for their dealership tech platform. The client’s repeated no-shows resulted in frustrations among team members, particularly expressed by James Shannon and Logan Bates. They discussed the pending project scope, emphasizing the need for clarity concerning BigQuery data access which is critical for the POC. Despite the client’s absence, the team maintained internal discussions about next steps and hiring needs, showcasing operational agility. The team’s camaraderie was evident in their informal interactions, which helped ease tension. Overall, the meeting highlighted the challenges of client unreliability and the necessity for effective communication strategies while balancing ongoing recruitment activities with client needs.
calls.keywords: Porsche, proof of concept, BigQuery, dealership technology, meeting attendance, Remy
